sourceSystem.description: Indicates the source system from which this canonical is imported

timestamp.description: Indicates the timestamp of the canonical in source system

sourcesId.description: Id of the {@link Sources} for the Source

workOrderNum.description: Work Order number from Source System

parent.description: Reference to parent for this work order

functionalLocation.description: Functional location of the work order. Used to connect work order to subsystem.

workOrderType.description: Type of work order: Planned vs. Unplanned

maintActivityType.description: Maintenance activity type: Predictive vs. Corrective Maintenance

priority.description: Priority of work order. Used identify the importance of the work order

requiredStartDatetime.description: Date time when work order was requested

actualStartDatetime.description: Date time when work order was started

actualFinishDatetime.description: Date time when work order was finished

maintItem.description: Reference to {@link Item}} for maintenance in this work order

totalActCosts.description: Identify importance of the work order

title: Represents a {@link WorkOrder}, which can be loaded from an external source.
name: CanonicalWorkOrder
